description: This file contains the core logic for an auditing system that evaluates invoices against a set of rules. It defines data structures, helper functions, rule evaluation logic, and the main function to run audits on invoices, including creating audit checks, findings, and audit runs.

classes.name: RuleResult
classes.description: Container class for the result of evaluating a single rule against an invoice, including status, message, and optional metadata.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_blacklist_from_description(description: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of vendor names from a rule description to identify blacklisted vendors.

methods.name: RuleResult _evaluate_rule(rule: AuditRule, invoice: Invoicelist)
methods.description: Evaluates a specific audit rule against an invoice, returning a result object with status, message, and metadata.

methods.name: Tuple[AuditFinding,bool] _get_or_create_open_finding_for(rule: AuditRule, invoice: Invoicelist, check: AuditCheck)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing open finding for a rule and invoice or creates a new one if none exists, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: AuditRun run_audit_for_invoice(invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filters: Optional[Dict] = None)
methods.description: Main function that runs all active audit rules against an invoice, recording audit checks, findings, and aggregating into an AuditRun object.

ctags.name: run_audit_for_invoice
ctags.pattern: /^def run_audit_for_invoice(invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filter/
ctags.signature: (invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filters: Optional[Dict] = None)
